description: A recruitment platform uses an AI system to parse CVs, score candidates, and automatically shortlist the top 20% for interviews at a logistics company.
ground_truth_basis: Annex III: AI systems used for recruitment and employment decisions (evaluation of candidates).
title: CV-screening AI for hiring

description: An online retailer deploys a chatbot that answers product and shipping questions from website visitors using scripted and generated replies.
ground_truth_basis: Transparency obligation: users must be informed they are interacting with an AI system; not high-risk per Annex III.
title: Customer-support FAQ chatbot

description: A municipal authority scores residents on civic behavior (littering fines, volunteer hours, online complaints) and uses the score to grant or deny access to public housing priority.
ground_truth_basis: Prohibited practice: social scoring by public authorities leading to detrimental treatment.
title: Government social scoring of citizens

description: An email provider uses a trained classifier to move suspected spam and phishing messages to the junk folder.
ground_truth_basis: No prohibition, no Annex III listing, no transparency trigger; standard low-risk AI use.
title: Email spam filter

description: A call center installs cameras that infer employee emotions (stress, frustration) from facial expressions to flag staff for wellness check-ins.
ground_truth_basis: Prohibited practice: emotion inference systems in workplaces and educational institutions.
title: Workplace emotion-recognition cameras

description: A hospital uses an AI system that highlights suspicious regions on chest X-rays to support radiologists in detecting pneumonia.
ground_truth_basis: Annex III: AI systems intended as safety components or used in healthcare/medical contexts; also a medical device under MDR.
title: AI-assisted radiology diagnosis

description: An e-commerce seller uses a generative model to draft marketing descriptions for handmade goods, reviewed by a human before publishing.
ground_truth_basis: Transparency obligation: AI-generated content must be disclosed as machine-generated where relevant.
title: AI-generated product descriptions

description: A regional police force uses an AI tool that scores individuals' likelihood of reoffending to prioritize parole supervision resources.
ground_truth_basis: Annex III: AI systems used by law enforcement for risk assessments of natural persons.
title: Predictive policing recidivism scores
